snippet.title: Bootleg in Wonderland ~ Pastel Paradise v1.1.0
snippet.description:
Bootleg rookie magician Yuuto Ichika finds herself lost in a strange, yet familiar world, only to be found by the young magician Alice.

What adventures await them in Wonderland?

Journey with Yuuto and Alice through a 3 stage bullet hell shmup adventure in Bootleg in Wonderland ~ Pastel Paradise!

v1.1.0 is out now with Caravan Mode: an intense single stage score attack mode, and Deviation Light: a new spell type for aggressive playstyles, alongside countless other tweaks and fixes!

https://crows-nest.itch.io/bootleg-in-wonderland
